provenance_reconciliation: Canonical v17 has49/44. The previously delivered local v17 adds a write-elision lemma and D45 but was not the same artifact as remote v17. Both are retained; D45 is explicitly imported here, and D46–D48 are new. No historical ledger is replaced.
assessment_policy: Correctness, concrete contribution, priority and fertility are separate. A physical synthesis, application or adapted proof can be innovative even when event-triggered control and matrix tools are established.

branch_additions.title: Continuation-certified work suppression with a priced physical selector
branch_additions.hypothesis: A physically realizable acquisition selector can remove semantically invisible writes while paying for its own installation and invocations; stochastic false omissions require a quantitative survival certificate.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: A useful abstract omission rule still uses free logic, a common operating bundle hides acquisition expenditure, or gate failures are averaged without distinguishing their consequences.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Same v16 plant; two readable inputs (executed service, pre-balance3); up to2 faulty NAND;16 whole maintenance programs; exact rational synthesis and a separate expected acquisition-workload ledger.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: A realizable program, independent raw-event oracle, exact price condition, a strict tolerance guarantee, and a failed-proof witness under a changed resource ledger.
branch_additions.contribution: One NAND realizes all-horizon lossless elision;1024 raw circuit/maintenance programs represented by336 channels; explicit cost break-even; finite8-cycle tolerance threshold gamma≈.00825224817; exact fault-direction and changed-budget falsifiers.

branch_updates.evidence: The omitted update lies in a continuation-null direction; harmful and harmless selector faults are now separated exactly.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Uniform omission interfaces for multiple future tasks under noisy realizable update libraries, with a loss tolerance and a separating test when task authority changes.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: A finite-horizon average guarantee is silently promoted to all contexts or indefinite safety.
branch_updates.minimal_test: One additional continuation that reads the interim record; verify whether DQ remains zero and identify the first witness.

branch_updates.evidence: Installation, gate invocation and write counts are jointly priced. The selector can be uneconomic; refunding saved work to the operational ledger changes the dynamics.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: A unified pathwise acquisition/actuation budget with a shared noisy selector, including the feedback from saved resources to future information demand.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: Expected workload prices are presented as measured energy or a refund is introduced without recertifying the old omission proof.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Two whole resource-accounting libraries; a costed attaining program and a necessity/lower-bound certificate.

imported_local_lessons.claim: Every newly available diagnostic must be written to preserve all future survival guarantees.
imported_local_lessons.reason: The service-from3 branch leads to forced skip at balance2 and subsequent renewal. D1=0 and DQ=0 certify omitting that interim write for all finite horizons.

rejected_additions.claim: Removing writes automatically reduces the total cost of the physical controller.
rejected_additions.reason: The NAND must be installed and executed. Expected cost improves iff c_w S>c_I+c_g E; a high gate price reverses the conclusion without changing survival.

rejected_additions.claim: All write-selector faults have the same effect on operational value.
rejected_additions.reason: An extra write on the safe omission branch has zero survival derivative; false omissions in the other three contexts have negative contributions. The final write also has no retrospective survival effect.

rejected_additions.claim: A write-elision certificate remains valid after its saved cost is refunded to the actuation balance.
rejected_additions.reason: A refund changes the post-service balance from2 to3, enabling a maintenance choice that can use the retained record. The old DQ=0 proof no longer applies; the measured value changes.
